root_cause.text: The `subreq` pointer in the `netfs_retry_read_subrequests` function is not initialized before the jump to the `abandon` label when a subrequest does not have the `NEED_RETRY` flag set, causing the abandonment process to operate on an uninitialized or stale pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `subreq = from;` immediately before the `goto abandon;` statement in `fs/netfs/read_retry.c` within the conditional block checking `!test_bit(NETFS_SREQ_NEED_RETRY, &from->flags)`, ensuring the pointer references a valid subrequest before abandonment logic executes.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds `subreq = from;` before the `goto abandon;` statement and sets `subreq = NULL;` after discarding subrequests, directly addressing the CVE description which states `subreq` "will be uninitialised on the first pass through the loop" and causes remaining subrequests to be incorrectly abandoned.
